record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, jointly set MAXLEN=64, batch size=256 and learning rate=1e-3, retaining dropout=0.1. Most observed histories fit within 64 positions; reducing padded attention computation makes room for a larger batch, while the moderate learning-rate increase compensates for its lower gradient noise. Preserve BERT4Rec modules, representation, loss, optimizer type, readout, seed 42, 200 batches per epoch and the 200-epoch cap; save matching predictor metadata.

category_rationales.rationale: Jointly test MAXLEN=64, batch size=256 and learning rate=1e-3 across all four datasets, retaining dropout=0.1. Shorter sequences reduce attention computation to accommodate larger batches; the increased learning rate complements the larger batch. The prior MAXLEN=64/LR=6e-4 regression makes this combination exploratory. Existing checkpoint metadata and predictor loading preserve matching sequence dimensions. Model definitions, loss, Adam optimizer, seeds and training limits remain unchanged.
